title: The values of a table constructor filter nothing, whatever they contain

source.quote: The query returns the same value in the Amt column for all the rows
source.supports: the article does this with DATATABLE: strings with no lineage give the same value on every row

source.quote: What really matters is only the data lineage of a column, which is the original column the values have been retrieved from
source.supports: the content of a column does not matter, only its lineage

derivation: The constructor's [Value] column has no lineage. Context transition on it filters no model column: both rows get the total, 100 + 40 + 20 + 50 + 200 + 30 + 100 = 540.
